caption: Under a dim overcast sky, a flat field bordered by bare trees holds a large explosion cloud already churning at the center. Dark finger-like plumes rise from a dense billowing mass of pale gray-white smoke spreading low along the ground. A small dark fragment drifts in the upper-right sky, rising steadily toward the top-right corner while the camera stays fixed. Within the cloud, faint orange flecks of combustion appear near the right side and intensify. The fire brightens and swells, its warm light illuminating the smoke from within. Bright combustion spreads across the central and right portions, lighting the dark plumes from inside and casting warm tones on the surrounding smoke. The dark smoke keeps billowing upward while the pale base churns near the ground. The burning cloud continues to grow, its glow intensifying against the gray backdrop.
